note: Every resonance with a name in assets/registry/resonances.json needs a line here (key: the name), or the site build fails.
Pale Flame: Burning lasts longer, and the attacker gets a Fire accuracy buff.
Stormfire: Burning jumps to the nearest other enemy.
Blasting Flame: Knocks the target back one cell and sets the cells around it on fire.
Stinging Flame: A crit always burns; Penetration comes together with Burning.
Burning Frost: Thaws a frozen target and deals damage for the Freeze turns removed.
Ringing Ice: Freeze jumps to the nearest other enemy.
Chilled Blood: Weakens the target together with Chill.
Cleaving Ice: Against a frozen target: a damage multiplier, and the Freeze shatters.
Piercing Frost: A crit always freezes and deals more damage to a frozen target.
Blood Arc: Bleeding jumps along a chain of up to three enemies.
Thunderclap: A chance to stun together with Shock.
Lightning Needle: The native state jumps to the next enemy in line behind the target.
Seething: A weaker Burning comes together with Bleeding.
Chilling Wounds: Slows the target together with Bleeding.
Deep Wound: On a crit, Bleeding is stronger and lasts longer.
Frozen Ram: Stun lasts longer, and Chill comes with it.
Concussive Discharge: Stun jumps to the nearest other enemy.
Piercing Spark: A chance to shock together with Penetration.
Bloodletting: A crit always makes the target bleed.
Armor Breaker: Penetration grows with the target's armor.
